stories.title: Indian startup funding rises to $255 million
stories.summary: Indian startups raised $255 million across 20 deals in the first week of November, according to Inc42 data. This represents a 96 percent increase in funding volume compared to the previous week, even as the total number of deals fell by 38 percent.

stories.title: EloElo Group raises $80 million for micro dramas
stories.summary: EloElo Group has raised $80 million in a Series C round led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal. The company, which describes itself as India's No. 1 micro drama platform, currently offers a catalogue of more than 5,000 micro dramas to its users.

stories.title: Peppermint Robotics raises Rs 100 crore
stories.summary: Pune-based Peppermint Robotics has raised Rs 100 crore in a Pre-Series B round led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners. The startup plans to use the capital to expand manufacturing capacity and establish an assembly line in North America in the coming months.

stories.title: Fintech startup OneStack raises Rs 12.5 crore from Shepherd
stories.summary: OneStack, a fintech startup that builds banking and payments technology for cooperative banks, has raised Rs 12.5 crore in a funding round from new investor Shepherd's Hill and existing backers Pentathlon Ventures and AVNM Ventures. stories.title: OBSESS Raises Angel Funding to Build India’s Unified Fitness and Sports Ecosystem - Indian Startup Times
stories.summary: Delhi NCR-based fitness and sports technology startup OBSESS has raised angel funding to develop a unified digital ecosystem for India’s fitness and sports industry. The company aims to bring together consumers, service providers and businesses across fitness, sports, nutrition and wellness through an integrated platform.

stories.title: Capgrid Raises Rs 50 Cr In Pre-Series B Round Led By Hero Enterprise - BW Disrupt
stories.summary: CAPGRID, a manufacturing technology platform, has raised Rs 50 crore in a Pre-Series B funding round led by Hero Enterprise. Existing investors Anicut Capital, Nexus Venture Partners and Axilor Ventures also participated in the round. The company was co-founded by Dheeraj Tiwari and Himanshu Singh

stories.title: Blitz valuation reaches Rs 440 crore
stories.summary: Quick-commerce fulfilment startup Blitz has raised Rs 28.70 crore in a Pre-Series B round led by IvyCap Ventures. The funding values the company at Rs 440 crore. The capital is intended to strengthen operations and expand the firm's existing fulfilment network.

stories.title: Enrission India Capital participates in Ottonomy’s Rs 40.6 Cr funding round
stories.summary: AI-powered autonomous delivery robot developer Ottonomy has raised approximately Rs 40.6 crore ($4.2 million) in a post-seed funding round, with Japan-based venture capital firm Enrission India Capital participating in the investment. The fresh capital will support the company’s global expansion across healthcare and industrial automation,

stories.title: Future Secure AI raises $80 million
stories.summary: Future Secure AI has raised $80 million via convertible notes at a $1.2 billion valuation. The three-year-old startup builds AI co-workers for large organisations, assembling teams of AI agents that each have a name and a face. They are overseen by a human.

stories.title: Kalepa raises $75 million after five-year wait
stories.summary: Insurance AI startup Kalepa has raised $75 million in a Series B round at a $470 million valuation. The company, which reports being cash flow positive for over two years, waited five years between its Series A and this latest funding round.

stories.title: Journify raises $12 million for adtech expansion
stories.summary: Moroccan adtech startup Journify has raised $12 million in a Series A round led by Al Mada Ventures. The company, which provides ad signal infrastructure, says the funding will support expansion into the US and Europe at four times its previous valuation.

stories.title: Everstone AMC raises Rs 1,700 crore for private equity
stories.summary: Everstone AMC has secured Rs 1,700 crore in the first close of its Everstone Capital Partners India Fund. The fund, which targets mid-market companies through a control-oriented growth strategy, reached this milestone within three months of launch. The capital arrived from family offices, HNIs and NRI investors.

stories.title: Daksham Capital closes maiden consumer fund at Rs 125 crore
stories.summary: Daksham Capital has raised Rs 125 crore for its debut consumer-focused fund, DGV Fund I. The firm, which holds a Rs 150 crore greenshoe option, intends to deploy capital across 10 to 15 startups. The fund is registered as a Category II AIF with the regulator.

stories.title: Tech funding drops to 12-month low in October
stories.summary: Indian tech funding fell 24.3 percent month-on-month to $592 million in October, the lowest level in a year. While the number of funding rounds increased, late-stage investment plummeted 72 percent. Early-stage funding rose 114 percent sequentially, though the overall market remains down 56 percent year-on-year.

stories.title: SRI Fund supports 824 MSMEs with private capital
stories.summary: The government-backed Self-Reliant India Fund has leveraged nearly Rs 48,000 crore in private investment to support 824 MSMEs. The Ministry of MSME, which contributed Rs 10,000 crore to the initiative, expects to mobilise four times that amount from private investors to promote entrepreneurship across the country.

stories.title: Sequoia Capital shuts London office in global restructure
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital is closing its London office and ending its Arc and Scouts programmes as part of a major operational reset. The firm, which recently raised $10 billion, will also merge its early- and growth-stage investing teams. The move follows a leadership change one year ago.

stories.title: SEBI reviews dormant startup listing platform
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has formed a working group to assess the Innovators Growth Platform. Introduced in 2014 to help startups access public markets, the platform has seen little activity. The panel will determine if the framework remains relevant for innovation-led companies seeking capital.

stories.title: US venture funding hits $20.83 billion in October
stories.summary: US startups raised $20.83 billion in October, a 25 percent decline from September. Four mega-rounds accounted for over one-quarter of the total capital raised. Series A funding saw a notable surge, jumping 72 percent to $5.11 billion during the same period, according to the latest data.

stories.title: Billionaire-led companies capture majority of venture capital
stories.summary: Over half of all U.S. seed and venture investment this year has gone to just seven companies founded or led by billionaires. These firms, including OpenAI and SpaceX, raised more than $260 billion in equity funding. The concentration of capital among these familiar names is statistically evident.

stories.title: Saudi venture funding declines 29 percent
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia’s venture capital market recorded $1 billion in funding during the first nine months of 2026, a 29 percent year-on-year decline. Two mega deals accounted for over half of the total investment value. Excluding these large transactions, funding activity fell 50 percent compared to last year.

stories.title: Razorpay secures SEBI approval for IPO
stories.summary: Fintech firm Razorpay has received approval from SEBI for an initial public offering of up to Rs 6,000 crore. The company, which submitted its papers confidentially in June, is reportedly targeting a valuation of $5 billion. The firm has yet to announce a formal listing date.

stories.title: OYO parent reports Q1 profit of Rs 353 crore
stories.summary: Hospitality chain PRISM reported a consolidated profit of Rs 353 crore for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, up 17 percent year-on-year. The profit was largely driven by a deferred tax credit of Rs 244 crore. Operating revenue grew 35 percent to Rs 2,814 crore.

stories.title: Honasa Consumer plans hair colour expansion
stories.summary: Honasa Consumer, the parent company of Mamaearth, reported an 87 percent jump in second-quarter net profit to Rs 73 crore. The firm plans to enter the hair colour category to capture emerging demand. Its younger brands grew by over 45 percent during the September quarter.

stories.title: Nykaa profit triples in second quarter
stories.summary: Nykaa parent FSN E-Commerce Ventures reported a net profit of Rs 101 crore for the second quarter, more than tripling from Rs 33 crore a year earlier. Operating revenue rose 28 percent to Rs 3,006 crore, driven by the company's private label business and increased marketing income.

stories.title: Go Digit Q2 profit falls 31 percent
stories.summary: Insurtech Go Digit reported a 31 percent year-on-year decline in net profit to Rs 142 crore for the September quarter. The company's profit also dropped 62 percent sequentially. Insurance revenue saw a marginal increase of 1.7 percent, with motor insurance remaining the firm's largest business segment.

stories.title: Amagi Media Labs reports record quarterly profit
stories.summary: SaaS platform Amagi Media Labs reported a 30-fold increase in net profit to Rs 75 crore for the second quarter. Revenue grew 27 percent to Rs 476 crore, with the company citing operating leverage and cost efficiencies. Adjusted EBITDA more than doubled during the period.

stories.title: NLC India profit doubles as renewables IPO approved
stories.summary: NLC India shares rose 8 percent after the company reported a twofold increase in second-quarter net profit to Rs 1,381 crore. The board also approved an offer for sale for its renewables subsidiary's proposed IPO and declared an interim dividend of Rs 1.50 per share.

stories.title: Canva to cut 22 percent of workforce
stories.summary: Design software maker Canva is laying off 1,271 employees, or 22 percent of its staff, citing a growth slowdown. CEO Melanie Perkins stated that while the company has scaled significantly over thirteen years, it must restructure to address current market conditions. Success does not guarantee future results.

stories.title: Canva layoff package draws praise
stories.summary: Canva’s announcement of a 22 percent workforce reduction has received positive attention for its exit package. The restructuring affects 1,271 employees. Industry figures have described the company's approach to the layoffs as generous and transparent, contrasting with typical industry reactions to large-scale job cuts.

stories.title: Unacademy co-founder reviews Deepinder Goyal's Temple wearable
stories.summary: Unacademy co-founder Gaurav Munjal praised the lightweight design and sleep tracking of Temple, a wearable device from Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal. Munjal suggested the product has potential as a global brand built in India, though he noted the app interface requires improvement. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Aina unveils AI ring for predictive action
stories.summary: Bengaluru startup Aina has unveiled an AI-powered ring designed to anticipate user needs and control connected devices. Founded by former Ultrahuman executive Apoorv Shankar, the company spent 15 months in stealth. Pre-orders for the device, which features a screen and a proprietary operating system, start at $399.

stories.title: Cosmoserve Space raises $6 million for debris removal
stories.summary: Hyderabad-based Cosmoserve Space raised $6 million in a seed round led by Rebright Partners, bringing total funding to over $9 million. The company also inaugurated Base 1, described as India's first private facility for satellite servicing and space debris recovery. The facility includes microgravity simulation capabilities.

stories.title: Hyderabad startup opens private space debris recovery facility
stories.summary: Cosmoserve Space has opened Base 1, a facility the company claims is India's first private site for space debris recovery and satellite servicing. It is the sixth such facility globally, featuring space-vision systems and robotics. The site was inaugurated by Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh and D. Sridhar Babu.

stories.title: Dream11 CEO teases platform revamp for 2026
stories.summary: Dream11 CEO Harsh Jain announced plans to launch a revamped version of the platform by the end of 2026. Jain described the upcoming product as being built by sports fans for sports fans. The company has not disclosed specific features or the commercial model for the new release.

stories.title: Lenskart reports 21 percent revenue growth in second quarter
stories.summary: Lenskart CEO Peyush Bansal stated that operating leverage is improving following a 21 percent revenue increase in the second quarter. One year after its stock market debut, the company intends to maintain a focus on growth and supply chain investments to expand its presence in eyewear markets.

stories.title: Lenskart targets 25 percent Ebitda margin
stories.summary: Lenskart has outlined a long-term strategy to reach a 25 percent Ebitda margin through increased control over manufacturing and technology. The company clarified that this margin is not an immediate target, as it will continue to prioritise growth. Profitability remains a long-term ambition for the retailer.
